command:
set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('app/src/main/java/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/shizuku/ShizukuUserServiceProbe.java')
s=p.read_text()
old='probeName() + "\nerror=connect_timeout"'
if s.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'malformed timeout occurrences={s.count(old)}')
s=s.replace(old, 'probeName() + "\\nerror=connect_timeout"', 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
git diff --check; git diff -- app/src/main/java/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/shizuku/ShizukuUserServiceProbe.java; git add app/src/main/java/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/shizuku/ShizukuUserServiceProbe.java; git commit -m 'Fix Shizuku live timeout string literal'; git push origin HEAD:work/phase1-live-call-probes; NEW=$(git rev-parse HEAD); REMOTE=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/work/phase1-live-call-probes | awk '{print $1}'); echo new_head=$NEW remote=$REMOTE; test "$NEW" = "$REMOTE"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
